summary: Start and the line, filling B1's two slots through bar_qt.register_slot (bar_qt not edited). New workbench/line_finder.py (no Qt): the rows a typed line offers, each with a verb that is what Enter does (Open, Run, Calculate, Ask Kasandra, Explain, Edit): a sum through the one maths core (math_model, exact; 10/3 -> '3.333 (exact 10/3)'), an address, DOS words (dos_words, the Debian command beside), apps from their desktop entries (apps_catalog via apps_qt.listing), Windows words (control panel, cmd, notepad, explorer, task manager, regedit) with the Windows word beside, settings (console_qt.setting_rows), files (recent: Graphite's and recently-used.xbel; home: search_reach.home_names), the desk (search_reach.records), commands (OneBox.commands), Kernel operations by name, a program for the Terminal, and Ask Kasandra (always offered; first only for a request). New workbench/start_qt.py: Start rises above the Start slot (apps by kind, Pinned first; recent files; Lock, Suspend, Log out, Restart, Shut down through session_power's own run_lock/run_suspend/run_action), the cursor in the line, typing turns it into rows, Esc or the Windows key closes it, Win+E/D/L still work inside it; the line slot raises the rows above it. The Windows key: graphite-do 'start' (Super_L/Super_R), 'line' (Win+R, Win+S).

existing_tests_changed: tests_integrated/test_windows_hand.py KeysFromAnyApp.test_the_fluxbox_keys_file_names_each_key_and_graphite_do: 'Super_L :Exec ... apps' became '... start', because the Windows key now opens Start (the brief's B2 change).
decisions: Start and the line are one panel (start_qt.StartPanel, a Qt popup that holds the keyboard): the bar's window takes no focus, so the line on the bar is a press that raises the panel above the line slot with its own field; Start is the same panel in 'start' mode above the Start slot.

The Windows key: Fluxbox runs graphite-do on the key's press and holds the keyboard until it is let go; a Qt popup whose grab fails closes at once (found in the smoke). Start therefore waits (at most 2 s, probing with XGrabKeyboard) until the keyboard is free, then rises: it rises on the key's release, as Windows' Start does. graphite-do answers 'Start rises once the Windows key is let go.'

Ask Kasandra is always the last row and is first (Enter's row) only when the words read as a request (a '?' lead or ending, a question word first, K4's objective reading, or four words or more that 1.0's reading gives her) and nothing else matched first; Familiar said Kas is never Enter's default, 1.0's foot made her the default for her words: every row names its verb, so Enter is never a surprise.
Enter on a sum puts the exact answer in the line and copies it (the panel stays, so the sum goes on); a sum the core refuses after '=' says why with the verb Edit. Displayed with x for *.
Start's empty line chooses nothing: Enter does nothing until Down or Tab chooses (Tab walks Apps, Recent, Power; Left/Right in Power).
Start's own lists show the verb on the chosen or hovered row only (the line under them says 'Enter: Open X'); the line's rows show it on every row.

Power shows the five the coordinator named (the leave group without Return to Debian, which stays in the System menu); availability is read off the window's thread on each opening; one not offered is drawn quiet with a slash, the caption says 'slashed: not here', its tip and a press say why.
Things that live in Graphite's window (settings, the desk, commands, the Terminal, her column, power's questions) bring Graphite forward first; apps, files in their apps and addresses do not.
Windows words handled in line_finder (WINDOWS table) rather than a new synonyms.py; 'control panel' opens Graphite's Settings until C1.
Win+R and Win+S bind to the line (graphite-do 'line'), per Familiar's keys table.
No Kernel operation added; registry unchanged.
findings_for_the_coordinator: Only real Fluxbox can confirm the Windows key timing (press vs release) and that Start then holds the keyboard; the smoke simulated the held key with another client's XGrabKeyboard.
The 1.0 'Apps' button at the top right of Graphite's window still opens 1.0's Apps panel (K0's head work); graphite-do 'apps' still exists.
Xvfb smoke needs LD_LIBRARY_PATH=b100/S3/xcblibs and a short XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: the door's socket path under the scratchpad is too long for AF_UNIX.
Opening a folder found by the line uses search_reach.open_home (1.0's board focus); E1 may want it to open in the Explorer instead.
not_done: Pin/unpin from Start, 'All apps' as a separate A-Z page, and apps' own icons from icon themes beyond apps_catalog's icon_file (invented apps show a letter tile).
Rise/fade motion (8 px, 160 ms): Start appears at once, as the bar's flyouts do.
Command... (the Power graft: 'keep as a word, pin, bind a key') on rows.
Nothing ran on the owner's ThinkPad.
release_note: Start: press the Windows key or Start on the bar. Your apps by kind, your recent files, and Lock, Suspend, Log out, Restart and Shut down. Type straight away: the line finds and does apps, files, settings, commands, DOS words and sums (12*7 gives 84, exactly), or asks Kasandra. Every row says what Enter will do. Win+R opens the line; Esc closes.
